title: Macroprudential Policy and Downside Risk: Regime-Dependent Effects of Capital Regulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper employs a Threshold Bayesian Vector Autoregression (TBVAR) to estimate the regime-dependent macroeconomic effects of capital regulation in Hungary. Using the Factor-based Index of Systemic Stress (FISS) as the threshold variable, the model identifies normal and stress regimes consistent with the occasionally binding constraints literature. The TBVAR offers a practical multivariate alternative to Growth-at-Risk for data-constrained economies. Generalised impulse responses reveal a pronounced asymmetry: releasing regulatory capital during stress raises GDP growth at the peak, with effects persisting for roughly twenty months, while the cost of accumulating capital in the normal regime is economically negligible. These findings are robust to alternative Cholesky orderings, sample periods, and credit variable definitions, providing direct empirical support for the countercyclical operation of the capital buffer.

translated_title: 宏观审慎政策与下行风险：资本监管的体制依赖性效应
translated_abstract: 本文采用阈值贝叶斯向量自回归模型（TBVAR）来估计匈牙利资本监管的体制依赖性宏观经济效应。使用基于因子的系统性压力指数（FISS）作为阈值变量，该模型识别出与偶发约束文献一致的正常和压力体制。TBVAR为数据受限经济体提供了增长风险（Growth-at-Risk）的实用多变量替代方法。广义脉冲响应显示出显著的不对称性：在压力时期释放监管资本会提高GDP增长的峰值，效应持续约二十个月，而在正常体制下积累资本的成本在经济上可忽略不计。这些发现对替代的Cholesky排序、样本期和信贷变量定义具有稳健性，为资本缓冲的反周期操作提供了直接的经验支持。
tldr: 本文通过阈值贝叶斯向量自回归模型发现，资本监管在压力时期释放资本能显著提升GDP增长且效应持久，而在正常时期积累资本成本可忽略，支持资本缓冲的反周期操作。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a Threshold Bayesian VAR to show that releasing regulatory capital during stress significantly boosts GDP growth with persistent effects, while accumulating capital in normal times is costless, supporting countercyclical capital buffers.
